dependency: All same-arena candidate and contemporary A/A gates, narrow integration source audit, production Metal compilation, release host tests/build, and fresh full 32K/128 C0 must pass before timing.
measurement: Existing engine-measure with correctness collection and profiling disabled; parse through existing strict Rust measurement adapter. Fresh process per run with built-in model page warming and residency. Warm-up observations preserved but excluded.
failure_policy: Stop on correctness, executable/source drift, allocation, command failure or invalid timing metadata; preserve everything. No discretionary repeats or threshold adjustment. Any failed speed criterion means do not select this change as an engine improvement; restore runtime if no other justified reason to retain. No claim of statistical significance or DwarfStar advantage.
reporting: All raw runs; each metric median/MAD/min/max, every paired ratio, order subsets, first-token latency, process wall time and peak RSS. State scratch cost and 32K-only validated scope.
